name: Quadriceps Tendon Partial Tear
definition: Partial disruption of quadriceps tendon fibers with preserved but weakened knee-extension mechanism.

investigations.principle: Ultrasound or MRI defines tear extent and retraction.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Immobilization/protected activity for selected partial tears
amber: High-grade tears may require operative repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu/Uru-Snayu tear phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Partial disruption of quadriceps tendon fibers with preserved but weakened knee-extension mechanism.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
